rationale.intuition: Emory overall RD ~10.29%, ED1 ~23.23%, ED2 ~10% (industry — pool is smaller and admit count lower than ED1 but still above RD). Strong domestic profile (3.92/1510 squarely in the 25-75 band of 1480-1540) with credible health-sciences narrative should land mid-band of ED2 admits — counselor consensus 12-30%. Lower bound reflects that ED2 pool already self-selected for fit and applicants are typically Emory-yield-protected; upper bound caps below ED1 lift because ED2 admit absolute count is half of ED1.

sources.name: Emory CDS 2024-25 (C21)
sources.evidence: Section C21 reports separable ED I (admit rate 23.23%) and ED II rounds; ED2 admit count ~half of ED1 with similar yield.

sources.name: Emory Wheel — 2024 ED2 Coverage
sources.evidence: Emory Wheel reported Emory ED2 admit rate ~10% for Class of 2028 cycle, materially below ED1 23% but above RD 10.29% on like-for-like basis.

sources.name: College Kickstart ED2 Benchmark 2024
sources.evidence: Emory ED2 admit rate ~10% per College Kickstart aggregation; among T20 ED2 schools, Emory's ED2 falls in the 8-15% band for class of 2028.

sources.name: Crimson Education ED2 Strategy Guide 2024
sources.evidence: Strong unhooked T20 ED2 applicants in the 25-75 test/GPA band cluster 12-25% admit rate — narrower band than ED1 because ED2 yield-protection is less aggressive.
